deploy.startCommand: echo "### STEP 1: shell alive, PORT=[$PORT] ###"; alembic upgrade head; echo "### STEP 2: alembic exited rc=$? ###"; python -u -c "import time,sys; t=time.time(); import sourcemind.main; print(f'### STEP 3: app imported OK in {time.time()-t:.1f}s ###', flush=True)"; echo "### STEP 4: import step exited rc=$? ###"; exec uvicorn sourcemind.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-8000} --workers 1 --log-level debug
